# Four invoices, each paid once, so that one edit can be made to each field
# of a payment.
#
# The comparison that answers "does the book already say this?" reads a
# payment block field by field — the date, the amount, the memo, the number on
# the bank transaction, and how much of it was left over as a prepayment. A
# field left out of it is one a person can correct in the ledger, import, and
# see reported `unchanged`: the payment in the book keeps the old figure, and
# nothing says so.
#
# One payment per invoice, because the comparison pairs a document's payments
# off against its blocks and stops at the first that does not match.
#
# invoice_payments_after_an_edit.txt is this file with one field changed in
# each.
#
# What this fixture produces: four posted invoices, each paid in full.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_an_edited_payment_lands.py.
2026-01-01 open Income
  type: Income
  commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
  commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Income:Sales
  type: Income
  commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
  commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets
  type: Asset
  commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
  commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank
  type: Bank
  commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
  commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Accounts Receivable
  type: Accounts Receivable
  commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
  commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

customer "C-PAY"
  name: "Paying Customer"
  currency: CAD

invoice "PAY-DATE"
  customer_id: "C-PAY"
  currency: CAD
  date_opened: 2026-01-01
  entry:
    date: 2026-01-01
    description: "A line"
    account: "Income:Sales"
    quantity: 1
    price: 100
    taxable: false
    tax_included: false
  posted:
    date: 2026-01-01
    due: 2026-01-31
    ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable"
    memo: "Invoice PAY-DATE"
    accumulate: true
  payment:
    date: 2026-01-15
    amount: 100
    bank_account: "Assets:Bank"
    memo: "Paid PAY-DATE"
    num: "CHQ-1"

invoice "PAY-AMOUNT"
  customer_id: "C-PAY"
  currency: CAD
  date_opened: 2026-01-01
  entry:
    date: 2026-01-01
    description: "A line"
    account: "Income:Sales"
    quantity: 1
    price: 100
    taxable: false
    tax_included: false
  posted:
    date: 2026-01-01
    due: 2026-01-31
    ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable"
    memo: "Invoice PAY-AMOUNT"
    accumulate: true
  payment:
    date: 2026-01-15
    amount: 100
    bank_account: "Assets:Bank"
    memo: "Paid PAY-AMOUNT"
    num: "CHQ-1"

invoice "PAY-MEMO"
  customer_id: "C-PAY"
  currency: CAD
  date_opened: 2026-01-01
  entry:
    date: 2026-01-01
    description: "A line"
    account: "Income:Sales"
    quantity: 1
    price: 100
    taxable: false
    tax_included: false
  posted:
    date: 2026-01-01
    due: 2026-01-31
    ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable"
    memo: "Invoice PAY-MEMO"
    accumulate: true
  payment:
    date: 2026-01-15
    amount: 100
    bank_account: "Assets:Bank"
    memo: "Paid PAY-MEMO"
    num: "CHQ-1"

invoice "PAY-NUM"
  customer_id: "C-PAY"
  currency: CAD
  date_opened: 2026-01-01
  entry:
    date: 2026-01-01
    description: "A line"
    account: "Income:Sales"
    quantity: 1
    price: 100

  posted:

    memo: "Invoice PAY-NUM"
    accumulate: true

    memo: "Paid PAY-NUM"
